Figure S16 – External granular layer (EGL) cell density

GCP density (detections / layer area) vs gestational age at birth (A) and post-menstrual age at death (B)

2026-08-06 15:30:33

Overview

External granule layer (EGL) cell density (granule-cell precursors, GCPs) for the post-mortem histopathology cohort, in the Figure 3 design (same palette, point/line sizes, axis ranges, and on-figure statistics). Density = pooled detections ÷ pooled layer area per subject (one value/subject). Axes and preterm/term grouping are taken from the Figure 3 dataset so the cohort matches exactly.

  • A — EGL density vs gestational age at birth (single OLS trend across all subjects; dashed line at 37 wk).
  • B — EGL density vs post-menstrual age at death (separate preterm/term trends with 95% CI ribbons; per-group slope β [95% CI] and slope-difference P on-figure).

Figure S16A – EGL density vs gestational age at birth
